text:
maria_cs: FYI Asteron Analytics renewal stuck. Customer signed commercial but procurement won't attach PO because vendor code missing and finance needs a signed SOW with corrected billing term. link to quote: https://docsend.com/s/asteron-q2.

devin_ae: what's the billing term issue? they asked to swap from net30 -> net45?

maria_cs: yes they requested net45 for EU entity. Sales approved discount but legal flagged language mismatch in section 4 re: payment schedule. need small change + esign.

lisa_legal: i reviewed. change: replace "payment due within 30 days" -> "payment due within agreed net45" and add sentence: "Customer remains responsible for prorated charges on seat downgrades." i can sign off if applied.

paul_se: i'll patch the SOW and generate DocuSign. who is primary signer on customer side?

maria_cs: procurement contact is jessica@asteron.ai and CFO is ryan@asteron.ai. they also want PO number before attaching. customer says they'll add PO once vendor code is provided.

procurement_bot: Vendor code lookup: no exact match for "Asteron Analytics Ltd". Suggest submitting vendorCode creation request to finance team with company registration number.

oliver_fin: tagging in. i can issue temp vendor code TEMP-VEND-901 to unblock PO attachment. will need PO scan + final vendor request form later.

devin_ae: awesome. paul can you include temp code in DocuSign note so customer can attach PO quickly?

paul_se: done. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ast-2024-55 routed to Ryan (CFO) then Jessica (procurement). included legal-approved clause. envelope expires in 7 days.

maria_cs: noted. timeline: customer asked for renewal to be effective immediately after signature. we need both signature + PO attached to mark as closed. i told them we can process same day if both arrive by 5pm GMT.

paul_se: Ryan viewed at 1735893000, partially signed? looks like he signed signature block but missed checkbox for billing terms. nudging now.

lisa_legal: small reminder: ensure the amended phrase is verbatim. paste below for copy/paste: `"Payment is due within agreed net45 days from invoice date. Fees are prorated for seat reductions effective at renewal."`

maria_cs: dropping that to customer in thread.

oliver_fin: temp vendor code issued. FIN-TEMP-901. i emailed procurement contact with instructions to attach PO to the DocuSign envelope.

devin_ae: customer responded: attaching PO now, final signature pending. thanks all.

maria_cs: status update: signed by Ryan at 1735894520, PO attached, finance to process invoice. closing after finance confirms vendor creation. great job team :tada:
